Part 2&3 物品 OBJECTS

Describe a plan that you had to change recently

描述你最近不得不改变的一个计划

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe a plan that you had to change recently

  • When this happened (这件事发生在什么时候)
  • What made you change the plan (是什么让你改变计划)
  • What the new plan was (新计划是什么)
  • And how you felt about the change (并谈谈你对这次变化的感受)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe a plan that you had to change recently

I'd like to talk about a plan I had to change last month. I was supposed to go hiking with two of my friends on a Saturday, and we'd been looking forward to it for weeks, because we'd booked the tickets and everything. However, the night before, one of my friends called to say he had a sudden family emergency and couldn't make it. At first, I thought we could just go without him, but then the weather forecast said there would be heavy rain all weekend, so we had no choice but to cancel the whole trip. Instead, we changed the plan to a simple indoor gathering. We met at a hotpot restaurant near my place, and honestly, it turned out to be quite enjoyable. We still got to catch up and talk about our lives, which was the real reason we wanted to meet in the first place. As for how I felt, I have to admit I was pretty frustrated at the beginning. I'm the kind of person who doesn't handle sudden changes well, because my schedule gets completely messed up. But looking back, I think it was a blessing in disguise, since we avoided getting soaked in the rain and still had a good time together.

上个月和朋友约好周六去爬山，结果朋友临时有家事、天气预报又说下大雨，只好改成在附近火锅店聚餐；一开始很难受，因为我不喜欢安排被打乱，但后来觉得因祸得福，躲过了大雨还聊得很开心。

Q2Do people often change their plans?

Yes, I think changing plans is very common in modern life. The main reason is that life is unpredictable, things like work emergencies, bad weather or sudden illness can easily force people to adjust. Also, with so many options available these days, people tend to change their minds more easily, for example, they might book a trip and then switch destinations after seeing better deals. That said, I think frequent changes can be stressful, so most people try to keep their important plans stable.

很常见，生活不可预测（工作突发、天气、生病）；选择多也让人更容易改主意；但频繁改动会带来压力。

Q3Would you tell others if you change your plan?

I think it depends on the situation. If the change affects other people, like a group gathering or a work meeting, then yes, I'd definitely inform them as soon as possible, because it's a matter of respect. However, if it's a personal plan that only involves me, like what to cook for dinner, then I wouldn't bother telling anyone. I mean, communication is important, but it should be proportional to how much the change affects others.

看情况：影响别人的计划一定尽早告知，这是尊重；只涉及自己的小事就不用说；沟通要与影响程度成正比。

Q4Why do you think parents still make plans for their children nowadays?

I think there are a couple of reasons. Firstly, many parents believe they know what's best for their children, based on their own life experience, so they plan things like study schedules or extracurricular activities. Secondly, society is quite competitive these days, and parents worry that without careful planning, their children might fall behind. Having said that, I think parents should leave some room for children to make their own choices, because over-planning can actually reduce a child's independence.

一是父母觉得凭经验知道什么对孩子最好，二是社会竞争激烈怕孩子落后；但过度规划会削弱孩子的独立性。

Q5How does technology help people make plans?

Technology has made planning much easier and more efficient. For example, calendar apps remind people of upcoming events, and note-taking tools help them organize their tasks. Also, with online booking systems, people can arrange travel, restaurants and tickets in just a few minutes, which was unthinkable twenty years ago. I think the biggest advantage is flexibility, because if a plan changes, people can adjust everything online instantly. That said, technology can't replace careful thinking, it's just a tool that supports decision-making.

日历提醒、笔记工具、在线预订让规划更高效灵活；计划变了可以随时在线调整；但技术只是工具，不能替代思考。
